name: Erie County, NY
findings: Erie County has 3,765 nonprofit organizations. 1,637 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,370 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Erie County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 80 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 34 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
